title: 2021 Fall AMC 12A Problem 9
statement: A right rectangular prism whose surface area and volume are numerically equal has edge lengths \(\log_2 x,\) \(\log_3 x,\) and \(\log_4 x.\) What is \(x?\)

solutions.text:
Let \(a = \log_2 x,\) \(b = \log_3 x,\) \(c = \log_4 x.\) Surface area equals volume gives \(2(ab + bc + ca) = abc.\) Dividing by \(abc,\) \[ 1 = 2\left(\frac{1}{c} + \frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}\right). \]

Since \(\dfrac{1}{a} = \log_x 2,\) etc., the sum is \(\log_x 2 + \log_x 3 + \log_x 4 = \log_x 24.\) Thus \(1 = 2\log_x 24,\) so \(\log_x 24 = \tfrac{1}{2},\) meaning \(x^{\frac{1}{2}} = 24\) and \(x = 576.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: With edges \(a, b, c,\) the equation \(abc = 2(ab + bc + ca)\) divides to \(1 = 2\left(\tfrac{1}{a} + \tfrac{1}{b} + \tfrac{1}{c}\right)\)
